subject: design/config-driven-portability-v1
statement: the hooks drop their branch/remote literals and let `pyxis` resolve them from config at invocation. The hook body is then identical in every repository — no per-repo rendering, no drift surface — and stays engine-verbatim (converge repairs it byte-exact). Runtime resolution is the natural extension of a surface that already delegates to the Go binary.
